name: Kashmir Complete Explorer
description: Explore the full beauty of Kashmir with this comprehensive 10-day itinerary covering all major destinations. From the iconic Dal Lake to the scenic valleys of Pahalgam, the snowy peaks of Gulmarg, and the golden meadows of Sonmarg — this trip offers everything Kashmir has to offer.
route: Srinagar → Gulmarg → Pahalgam → Sonmarg → Doodhpathri → Yusmarg → Srinagar
highlights: Visit all Mughal Gardens — Nishat, Shalimar, Chashme Shahi
Full-day Gulmarg excursion with optional Gondola
Pahalgam sightseeing with Aru, Betaab & Chandanwari
Sonmarg day trip – the Meadow of Gold

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Srinagar Airport. Transfer to houseboat on Dal Lake. Evening Shikara ride. Overnight at houseboat.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Local Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Visit Mughal Gardens — Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Chashme Shahi. Visit Hazratbal Shrine and Shankaracharya Temple. Overnight in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg
itinerary.desc: Drive to Gulmarg. Explore meadows and take optional Gondola ride for panoramic views. Overnight in Gulmarg.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg to Pahalgam
itinerary.desc: Drive to Pahalgam via Srinagar. Stop at Awantipora ruins en route. Check in and explore Pahalgam town. Overnight in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Visit Aru Valley, Betaab Valley, Baisaran, and Chandanwari. Enjoy horse riding or nature walks. Overnight in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam to Srinagar
itinerary.desc: Drive back to Srinagar. Shopping for Kashmiri Pashmina and handicrafts. Overnight in Srinagar hotel.

itinerary.title: Sonmarg Excursion
itinerary.desc: Full day trip to Sonmarg. Visit Thajiwas Glacier and enjoy the scenic beauty. Return to Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Doodhpathri Excursion
itinerary.desc: Excursion to Doodhpathri – the Valley of Milk. Explore beautiful meadows and streams. Return to Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Yusmarg Excursion
itinerary.desc: Excursion to Yusmarg, a peaceful meadow surrounded by forests. Visit Nilnag Lake. Return to Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Transfer to Srinagar Airport. Departure with unforgettable memories.

inclusions: Airport pickup and drop in Srinagar
Private vehicle for transfers and sightseeing
Driver allowance, fuel, toll, and parking charges
exclusions: Local sightseeing transport in Gulmarg, Pahalgam, Doodhpathri, and Sonmarg
Adventure activities such as skiing, Gondola ride, paragliding, etc.
Entry fees and camera charges at monuments
essentialTips: Follow local rules and respect traditions
